## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, `ci:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `build:`, `perf:`)
- [ ] Linked OpenSpec change (or "none" above)
- [ ] `openspec validate --all --strict` passes locally
- [ ] No secrets, Patreon feed URLs, or feed dumps (fixtures are synthetic or redacted)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, CONTRIBUTING, runbooks) where behavior or process changed
- [ ] Self-review done: read the full diff on GitHub before merging
